name_zh: 也门·胡塞运动：扎伊德什叶抵抗与导弹红海
name_en: Yemen Houthi Movement: Zaydi Shia Resistance & Missiles Red Sea
description_zh: 胡塞运动 (2004-) 也门扎伊德派什叶武装，以真主党模式对抗沙特领军联军，红海发射反舰导弹威胁全球航运，伊朗支持下成为地区地缘政治关键变量。
description_en: Houthi Movement (2004-) Yemen Zaydi Shia armed group, Hezbollah model resisting Saudi-led coalition, Red Sea anti-ship missiles threatening global shipping, Iran-backed becoming regional geopolitics key variable.
reason_zh: 胡塞代表少数派教派武装如何通过非对称战争与导弹威慑改写地区战略平衡，展示了红海航运安全如何成为大国博弈新战场，其扎伊德身份与伊朗支持形成独特意识形态混合体。
reason_en: Houthis represent how minority sectarian armed group rewrites regional strategic balance through asymmetric warfare and missile deterrence, demonstrating how Red Sea shipping security becomes new great power competition battlefield, their Zaydi identity and Iran support forming unique ideological hybrid.
steps_zh: 研究胡塞创始人侯赛因·巴德尔丁·胡塞与扎伊德复兴
分析2004-2010六次战争与萨利赫联盟破裂
探讨2014占领萨那与沙特联军干预
评估红海导弹袭击商船与美英联军打击
总结扎伊德什叶抵抗导弹红海对地区地缘政治的重塑
steps_en: Study Houthi founder Hussein Badreddin Houthi and Zaydi revival
Analyze 2004-2010 six wars and Saleh alliance rupture
Explore 2014 Sanaa capture and Saudi coalition intervention
Evaluate Red Sea missile strikes on merchant ships and US-UK coalition strikes
Summarize Zaydi Shia resistance missiles Red Sea reshaping regional geopolitics
expected_zh: 理解少数派教派如何通过非对称军事能力获得战略话语权，掌握红海航运安全作为大国博弈新前沿的逻辑，评估胡塞模式对也门和平进程的根本阻碍。
expected_en: Understand how minority sect gains strategic voice through asymmetric military capability, grasp Red Sea shipping security as new great power competition frontier logic, evaluate Houthi model fundamental obstacle for Yemen peace process.
case_zh: 2004 起义；2014 占领萨那；2023 红海导弹；持续。扎伊德什叶抵抗导弹红海范式永存。
case_en: 2004 uprising; 2014 Sanaa capture; 2023 Red Sea missiles; ongoing. Zaydi Shia resistance missiles Red Sea paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Zaydi revival; asymmetric warfare; Red Sea security; Iran proxy
